newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbia EI-Nis values itself at 1 bln marks - agency.
newsitem.headline: Serbia EI-Nis values itself at 1 bln marks - agency.

text.p: BELGRADE, May 29 (Tanjug) - The value of Serbia's largest electronics company Elektronska Industrija (EI) from Nis was estimated at one billion German marks, Yugoslav news agency Tanjug reported on Thursday.

"EI's specialised directorate for transformation has estimated the company's approximate value with the aim of conducting its ownership restructuring as efficiently as possible," Djokica Jovanovic, head of directorate, was quoted as saying.
EI board of directors was urging speedy and efficient transformation of the company as a condition for development of new technology and arrival of foreign capital, Jovanovic said.
The company would conduct its transformation within Serbia's ownership transformation law, expected to be adopted shortly.
There was a possibility for the Serbian government to participate in the process, Jovanovic added.
